title: THE EVENING RAMP: PJM
subtitle: PJM: the median day's largest one-hour rise of net load between 2 PM and 10 PM local, 3,805 MW per hour in 2025, up from 2,484 MW per hour in 2019. The direction holds in 5 of the 6 full years after 2019.
